title: FoodsOnHand
subtitle: A late-2025 commission
description:
FoodsOnHand is your ultimate digital cookbook and culinary community, designed to inspire your cooking creativity and connect you with fellow food lovers.

title: Nicka's Bohol Motorbike & Car Rental
subtitle: An early-2025 commission
description:
Nicka's Bohol Motorbike & Car Rental is a service that provide top-quality motorbikes and cars for rent in Bohol, Philippines.
Vehicles are well-maintained, reliable, and perfect for exploring the beautiful island of Bohol at your own pace.

This was my first time working on a service portfolio kind of website that doesn't have much user interactivity.
It was not my strong suite so I hope my future commissions wouldn't be too similar.

title: Nowcast

description:
A weather and heat-health monitoring app.
Nowcast helps you keep an eye on current weather conditions, extreme-heat risk in your area, and location-tagged updates from other users.

title: SauceDB
subtitle: A simple database for archiving anime and manga sources.
description:
SauceDB is a simple database for archiving sources of anime and manga that took a little more effort to find.
This was one of my first projects and was mostly for personal use.

It was very useful back when I was running a Facebook page called "Anime SauceHub" dedicated to helping people find the source of images they provided.
Unfortunately, the page was taken down and I no longer do source hunting.

title: SaucePls
subtitle: An animanga-focused QnA website for content identification
description:
SaucePls is a social platform where people ask for the source of images they've found.
Users post unknown images as sauce requests, and the community helps identify them by adding tags, commenting, and providing answers.
The original poster (or a moderator) can then accept the correct sauce.

title: Wplace Color Converter
subtitle: oh hell nah not another wplace color converter
description:
Just another simple color conversion tool that converts the colors from a pixel art/image to the colors available in Wplace
It is one of the already many existing color conversion tools for Wplace out there.

Unlike many other tools such as PEPOAFONSO/color_converter_wplace and Yet Another Wplace Color Converter,
this tool allows the ability to estimate how long it would take to finish a project solo with and without the flag bonus.
